deviation: The draft gives Supplier all IP in the Services and any improvements, and is silent on deliverables created for Arcadia, so bespoke deliverables would stay with Supplier and no perpetual licence is granted. Arcadia would not own what it paid for or be sure it can keep using it. The feedback clause also gives Supplier an unrestricted right to use Arcadia's input.
suggested_text: The Customer owns all Customer Data and all deliverables created specifically for the Customer. The Supplier retains ownership of its pre-existing tools and grants the Customer a perpetual licence to use them within the deliverables. Except as expressly set out in this Agreement, no other rights are transferred by either party. Supplier may use Customer's feedback about the Services, provided it does not disclose Customer's confidential information and does not incorporate Customer Data or Customer-owned deliverables.
